svg.title: Mesh-Sim system overview
svg.desc: Scenario files and Python tools feed the simulator; the simulator runs setup once, then evaluates links, generates traffic, routes flows, writes outputs and optionally takes an RL step every tick; the run outputs are read by the visualizer.
svg.text: a Python tool runs the simulator
launch an already-built binary; never build it
EVERY TICKadvance the ns-3 clock, then:
JSON over stdin/stdout to the Python env
seed-N/positions, links, rx-power, mcs, flows, routes CSVs
